rows.description: A child humiliated by failure may hide, go silent or say they are stupid. Shame targets the self, so adults separate the person from the act and offer safety.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: shame, humiliation, trust

rows.description: A school-age child who broke a rule may avoid eye contact, over-explain or confess. Guilt is about an action and can lead to repair, and adults should keep it proportionate.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child begs with please, big eyes and a soft voice for something wanted. Pleading is a request for mercy, and adults can hear the need while still holding a fair limit.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child pats a friend, says it is okay or stays close after a fall. Reassurance works when it matches the friend's need, and empty promises should be avoided.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child stares blankly, fidgets or gives wrong answers when instructions are unclear. Confusion may be hidden by nodding, so asking them to explain back checks understanding.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child says really or how do you know when a claim sounds off. Healthy skepticism grows with learning to check sources and to accept good evidence.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child goes quiet, looks away or taps a chin while working out an answer. Silence often means thinking, so waiting a few extra seconds lets the child finish.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child hangs back before a new class, a doctor visit or a match. Apprehension is a cautious pause and eases with preview, practice and a supportive adult.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child exhales, slumps or laughs after a scary test or a lost item is found. Relief follows tension, and the physical drop may look like tiredness.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: amusement, relief, tiredness

rows.description: A school-age child asks what if questions, has stomach aches or cannot settle before a test. Worry shows as body signs, and listening and a simple plan help.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
